items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Not Marion Mann. No, before, right after Marion Mann.

ctx.x: Beautiful gal singer, she's a movie star. Ah. What the hell's her name? Goddamn, I told you she sang with the band too. Not Marion Mann. No, before, right after Marion Mann.
She was the one in the, no, she wasn't the one in the drum. No. She came in after her.
